name: Technical Innovation
description: Judges are looking for originality, feasibility, and technical depth.

name: Mission Impact
description: How well the solution aligns with defense priorities and real-world use cases.

name: Usability & Design
description: Clarity of the demo, ease of use, and potential for reuse or extension.

name: Security & Sustainability
description: Readiness for DoW testing, long-term viability, and maintainability.

name: Team Collaboration
description: Teamwork, presentation quality, and resilience under pressure.

name: Reach the Enterprise
description: Ability to integrate with a Marine Corps or DoW enterprise system.

name: Sanctioned and Approved
description: The developed solution incorporates the use of an already approved DoW platform or capability (GenAI.mil).

name: Living on the Edge
description: The solution incorporates use of edge computing providing localized capability to learn and train in austere environments at time of need and does not rely on cloud infrastructure or internet connectivity.

name: Supercharge
description: Solution set utilizes High Performance Computing Resources and or State of the Art methodology.
